values.value: If we started next week, how would an extract of your HubSpot estate actually be produced — and who would do it?

[{"value":1,"label":"No admin access, no owner, and nobody has exported anything from HubSpot before."},{"value":2,"label":"A super admin exists; private-app tokens have not been created and would need someone's approval."},{"value":3,"label":"A super admin can create a private app with the needed scopes this week, and someone on the team can run an operator-led extract."},{"value":4,"label":"A supported connector reads the source directly with no operator in the loop."}]
No HubSpot connector ships today. The best available path is an operator-run extract against a private app, which is what a 3 describes — so a 4 is not on offer for this pair, for anyone.
Ask who holds Super Admin, and whether private apps are permitted by their security team at all.
Worth checking before you answer: who holds HubSpot Super Admin, and whether your security team allows private apps at all.

docs/specs/tier-2/sfmc-next-target-adapter.md — the adapter matrix this accelerator ships covers Eloqua and SFMC as sources; there is no HubSpot source adapter, so the top anchor describes a capability that does not exist for this pair. Capping rather than silently rewording the 4 is what keeps this comparable to a pair where a 4 IS reachable: the same scale, with a stated ceiling, rather than a different scale wearing the same numbers.
